description: Track covers in the library list, the grid and the player are loaded at exactly the size they are shown at, so they stay sharp and scrolling does not resample them
steps: Set the display scale to 100% and start the app
Open the Library tab in list view and verify the covers are 64x64 pixels and look sharp
Switch to grid view and verify the covers are 160x160 pixels and look sharp
Play a track and verify the player cover is 64x64 pixels
Restart the app at 150% display scale and verify list and player covers are 96x96 pixels and grid covers are 240x240 pixels
Open a track with a non-square cover and verify it keeps its aspect ratio in the list and the grid
Open a track without a cover and verify its list and grid cover areas are empty
Scroll the grid quickly through a large library and verify no frames are spent resampling covers while drawing
Open the cover viewer and the track editor and verify they still show the large and original covers
out_of_scope: Limiting the in-memory cover cache by bytes
Delaying or cancelling cover loads while scrolling
Reloading covers when the display scale changes while the app runs
Fading covers in when they finish loading

description: The memory used by cached library covers is limited to a budget sized from how many covers fit in the visible area times a few screens, and does not grow with library size
steps: Open the Library tab in grid view with a library of 10000 tracks
Scroll through the whole library and verify the memory used by cached covers stays within the budget
Scroll back by one screen and verify the covers shown there appear without loading again
Enlarge the window so more tiles fit and verify the budget grows accordingly
Switch to list view and verify the budget accounts for the smaller list covers
Repeat with a library of 100 tracks and verify all covers stay cached
out_of_scope: A user setting for the cache size
Sizing the budget from the machine's total RAM
Delaying or cancelling cover loads while scrolling
Loading covers for rows outside the visible area

description: While scrolling the library, a cover starts loading only after its tile has stayed visible for a short time, loads for tiles that scroll away are cancelled, and the most recently shown tiles load first
steps: Open the Library tab in grid view with a large library
Scroll quickly from the top to the bottom and verify covers of tiles that only flashed by are not loaded
Stop scrolling and verify all visible covers appear shortly after
Scroll by one screen and stop, then verify the tiles now visible load before any that were scrolled away
Scroll away while covers are still loading and verify their loads are cancelled and they are not added to the cache
Scroll back to a screen whose covers are cached and verify they appear immediately, without the delay
Verify the same behavior in list view
Verify scrolling stays smooth while covers load
out_of_scope: Loading covers for rows just outside the visible area
Showing a placeholder image while a cover loads
Fading covers in when they finish loading

description: Once scrolling settles, covers of the rows just above and below the visible area are loaded in advance
steps: Open the Library tab in grid view with a large library
Scroll to the middle and stop
Verify covers of the rows just above and below the visible area are loaded after the visible ones
Scroll by one row and verify the newly visible row shows its cover immediately
Scroll quickly and verify no rows outside the visible area are loaded until scrolling settles
Verify prefetched covers stay within the memory budget
Verify the same behavior in list view
out_of_scope: Creating thumbnails for the whole library in the background

description: List and grid covers are kept on disk as PNG thumbnails in the OS cache directory, so a cover that is not in memory loads without reading the audio file again
steps: Start the app with an empty cache directory and open the Library tab in grid view
Verify each loaded cover creates a PNG in the OS cache directory named after the audio file and the pixel size, e.g. 'Metallica - Sad But True 160x160.png' at 100% scale
Switch to list view and verify a second thumbnail, e.g. 'Metallica - Sad But True 64x64.png', is created for the same track
Restart the app at 150% scale and verify thumbnails named '96x96' and '240x240' are created next to the old ones
Restart the app and verify covers load from the thumbnails without reading the audio files
Replace the cover of a track's audio file with another app and verify its thumbnails are regenerated on next load
Open a track without a cover, restart the app and verify its audio file is not read again to look for a cover
Delete the cache directory while the app is closed and verify the thumbnails are recreated on next load
out_of_scope: Creating thumbnails for the whole library in the background
Removing thumbnails of tracks that no longer exist
Storing the large covers of the cover viewer and track editor on disk
Sharing one thumbnail between tracks with identical covers

description: After the library loads, a background task creates every missing or outdated list and grid thumbnail without affecting the UI
steps: Start the app with an empty cache directory and a library of 10000 tracks
Verify thumbnails for every track are created in the background after the library loads
Scroll the grid while thumbnails are being created and verify scrolling stays smooth
Verify tracks already scrolled to are not created twice
Update the cover of a track's audio file with another app, restart and verify only that track's thumbnails are regenerated
Restart the app with all thumbnails up to date and verify no audio files are read for covers
Close the app while thumbnails are being created and verify no broken thumbnails are left
out_of_scope: Removing thumbnails of tracks that no longer exist

description: After the library loads, thumbnails of tracks that are no longer in the library are removed from the cache directory
steps: Start the app and let all thumbnails be created
Close the app, delete a track's audio file from the music directory and start the app again
Verify both thumbnails of the deleted track are removed
Rename a track's audio file and verify the thumbnails with the old name are removed and new ones are created
Verify thumbnails of the remaining tracks are kept
Verify files in the cache directory that are not thumbnails are left untouched
